<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Amire80" /></noinclude><section begin=par76 />quiescent, is made audible again by the helping {{GHGterm|S<sup>e</sup>ghôl}} (unless perhaps there is a confusion with the ''imperfect consecutive Hiphʿîl'' of {{GHGheb|text=יאל}}).

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|e}}
(''d'') Verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״י}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}} (cf. § 69, § 70, and § 74), as {{GHGheb|text=יָצָא|translate=to go forth, imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=צֵא|translate=go forth}}, with {{GHGheb|text=־ָה|translate=paragogic}} {{GHGheb|text=צֵ֫אָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=9|verse=29}} in principal pause for {{GHGheb|text=צְאָה}}; 2nd ''fem. plur.'' {{GHGheb|text=צְאֶ֫נָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ct|chapter=3|verse=11}}; {{GHGterm|infinitive}} {{GHGheb|text=צֵאת}}; {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הוֹצִיא|translate=to bring forth}}.—{{GHGheb|text=יָרֵא|translate=to fear, imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=יִירָא}} and {{GHGheb|text=וַיִּירָא}} (or {{GHGheb|text=וַיִּרָא}}), {{GHGterm|imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=יְרָא}}; {{GHGterm|imperfect Niphʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=יִוָּרֵא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=130|verse=4}}, {{GHGterm|participle}} {{GHGheb|text=נוֹרָא}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|f}}
(''e'') Verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״י}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} (cf. § 69, § 70, and § 75), e.g. {{GHGheb|text=יָדָה|translate=to throw}}, Hiphʿîl ''to confess, to praise'', and {{GHGheb|text=יָרָה|translate=to throw}} (both properly verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״ו}}), and {{GHGheb|text=יָפָה|translate=to be beautiful}}. {{GHGterm|Infinitive}} {{GHGheb|text=יָרֹה}}, {{GHGheb|text=יְרוֹת}}; {{GHGterm|imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=יְרֵה}}; {{GHGterm|imperfect consecutive}} {{GHGheb|text=וַיִּיף}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=31|verse=7}} (cf. also {{GHGheb|text=וַתִּ֫יפִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=16|verse=13|hidebook=1}}); with ''suffixes'' {{GHGheb|text=וַנִּירָם|translate=we have shot at them}} (from {{GHGheb|text=יָרָה}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=21|verse=30}}; perhaps, however, it should be read with the LXX {{GHGheb|text=וְנִינָם|translate=and their race}} (also in the very corrupt passage {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=74|verse=8}} {{GHGheb|text=נִינָם}} is probably a ''substantive'', and not the {{GHGterm|imperfect Qal}} with ''suffix'' from {{GHGheb|text=יָנָה}}); ''Piʿēl;'' {{GHGheb|text=וַיַּדּוּ}} for {{GHGheb|text=וַיְיַדּוּ}}, ({{GHGpar|69|u}}). {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הוֹדָה}}, {{GHGheb|text=הוֹרָה}}; {{GHGterm|infinitive}} {{GHGheb|text=הוֹדֹת}} (as {{GHGterm|infinitive absolute}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=7|verse=3}}); {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=יוֹרֶה}}, cf. {{GHGheb|text=אַל־תֹּנוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=22|verse=3}}; ''apocopated'' {{GHGheb|text=וַיּוֹר}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=13|verse=17}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|g}}
(''f'') Verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״וּ}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}}, particularly {{GHGheb|text=בּוֹא|translate=to come}}. {{GHGterm|Perfect}} {{GHGheb|text=בָּא}}, {{GHGheb|text=בָּ֫אתָ}}, {{GHGheb|text=בָּ֫את}} or {{GHGheb|text=בָּאתְ}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=16|verse=8}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=14|verse=3}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Mi|chapter=4|verse=10}}; cf. {{GHGpar|75|m}}), once {{GHGheb|text=בָּ֫נוּ}} for {{GHGheb|text=בָּ֫אנוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=25|verse=8}}; for {{GHGheb|text=בֹּאוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=27|verse=18}}, which is apparently the {{GHGterm|perfect}}, read {{GHGheb|text=יָבֹ֫אוּ}}. In the {{GHGterm|imperfect Qal}} the separating vowel occurs ({{GHGheb|text=תְּבֹאָ֫ינָה}} instead of the more common {{GHGheb|text=תָּבֹ֫אנָה}}, cf. also {{GHGheb|text=תָּבֹ֫אןָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=30|verse=38}}) only in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=9|verse=16}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=45|verse=16}}, and {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=10|verse=7}} {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|h}}
For {{GHGheb|text=וַתָּבֹאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=25|verse=34}} {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}} (the {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}} {{GHGheb|text=ותבאתי}} evidently combines the two readings {{GHGheb|text=וּבָאתְ}} and {{GHGheb|text=וַתָּבֹאִי}}; cf. Nestle, {{GHGcite|title={{abbr|ZAW.|Zeitschrift für die alttestamentliche Wissenschaft, ed. by B. Stade, Giessen, 1881 ff., and since 1907 by K. Marti.}}}} xiv. 319), read {{GHGheb|text=וַתָּבֹ֫אִי}}; on the impossible forms {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=33|verse=16}} and {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=22|verse=21}} cf. {{GHGpar|48|d}}.—In the {{GHGterm|perfect Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הֵבִיא}}, {{GHGheb|text=הֵבֵ֫אתָ}} and (only before a suffix) {{GHGheb|text=הֲבִיאֹתָ}}; the latter form is also certainly intended in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=14|verse=31}}, where the Masora requires {{GHGheb|text=וְהֵֽבֵיאתִ֫י}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=9|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=19|verse=25|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=43|verse=23}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=25|verse=13}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ct|chapter=3|verse=4}}. Before suffixes the ''ē'' of the first syllable in the 3rd ''sing.'' always becomes {{GHGterm|Ḥaṭeph-S<sup>e</sup>ghôl}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=הֱבִֽיאֲךָ}}, {{GHGheb|text=הֱבִיאַ֫נִי}}; elsewhere invariably {{GHGterm|Ḥaṭeph-Pathaḥ}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=הֲבֵאתָ֫נוּ}} or {{GHGheb|text=הֲבִֽיאֹתָ֫נוּ}}. On the other hand, ''ē'' is retained in the secondary tone in the {{GHGterm|perfect consecutive}} when without suffixes, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=וְהֵֽבֵאתָ֫}}. Cf. moreover, {{GHGheb|text=וַֽהֲקִאֹתוֹ}} ({{GHGheb|text=וַֽהֲקֵאֹתוֹ}} in Opitius and Hahn is altogether incorrect), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=25|verse=16}}, from {{GHGheb|text=קִיא}}; but {{GHGheb|text=קְיוּ|translate=spue ye}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=25|verse=27}} (perhaps only a mistake for {{GHGheb|text=קִיאוּ}}), is not to be referred to {{GHGheb|text=קִיא}} but to a secondary stem {{GHGheb|text=קָיָה}}. In the {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=וַתָּקִא}} is found once, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=18|verse=25}}, besides {{GHGheb|text=וַיָּקֵא}} (analogous to {{GHGheb|text=וַיָּבֵא}}).—On {{GHGheb|text=אָבִי}} (for {{GHGheb|text=אָבִיא}}), {{GHGheb|text=מֵבִי}}, {{GHGheb|text=יָנִי}}, see {{GHGpar|74|k}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|76|i}}
(''g'') The form {{GHGheb|text=חָיַי|translate=to live}}, in the {{GHGterm|perfect Qal}}, besides the ordinary development to {{GHGheb|text=חָיָה}} ({{GHGterm|fem.}} {{GHGheb|text=חָֽיְתָה}}), is also treated as a verb {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, and then becomes {{GHGheb|text=חַי}} in the 3rd ''pers. perfect'', in {{GHGterm|pause}} {{GHGheb|text=חָי}}, and with {{GHGterm|wāw consecutive}} {{GHGheb|text=וָחַי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=3|verse=22}}, and frequently. In {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=25|verse=36}} the contracted form {{GHGheb|text=וְחֵי}} is perhaps {{GHGterm|st. constr.}} of {{GHGheb|text=חַי|translate=life}}, but in any case read {{GHGheb|text=וָחַי|translate=perfect consecutive}} as in verse 35. The form {{GHGheb|text=וָחָ֫יָה}} occurs in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=1|verse=16}} in {{GHGterm|pause}} for {{GHGheb|text=וָחַ֫יָּה}} (3rd {{GHGterm|fem.}}) with {{GHGterm|Dageš}} omitted in the {{GHGheb|text=י}} on account of the pausal lengthening of ''ă'' to ''ā''.<section end=par76 /><noinclude>
<references/></noinclude>
